同一城市可能有多个供水区；开户前用完整街道地址核对服务商，公寓先问物业是否统一开: A city can contain multiple water service areas. Confirm the provider using the full street address before opening an account; apartment residents should first ask management whether service is shared.
仅服务部分地址；请按服务区地图或客服确认。: Serves only some addresses; confirm with the service-area map or customer service.
电力开户、迁移、停用及线路服务找 PG&E；发电供应方另列。: Contact PG&E to start, transfer or stop electric service and for power-line service; the electricity generation provider is listed separately.
负责发电采购；PG&E 继续负责线路、开户和合并账单。: Procures electricity generation; PG&E continues to handle power lines, account setup and the combined bill.
原名 Peninsula Clean Energy，2026 年 7 月改名；负: Formerly Peninsula Clean Energy, renamed in July 2026; procures electricity generation while PG&E handles power lines and account setup.
开户、停用和搬家请从此官方入口办理。: Use this official page to start or stop service when moving.
开户入口先选择服务区；客服确认地址后办理。: Select the service district in the account-opening portal and confirm the address with customer service.
开户、停用及账单由市政府公用事业客服办理。: The city's utility customer service handles account opening, closing and billing.
市营供水；使用本市开户入口。: Municipal water service; use the city's account setup page.
租住公寓或共用垃圾桶的住宅，先问物业谁负责账户及费用。: If you rent an apartment or share waste containers, first ask management who holds the account and pays the charges.
服务 Belmont 大部分地区；少数地址属于 Cal Water。: Serves most of Belmont; some addresses are served by Cal Water.
通过镇政府页面进入 Republic，按地址查询收运服务和联系入口。: Follow the town's link to Republic and use the service address to find collection information and contact options.
现行市政府专页将住宅垃圾开户、停用及账单咨询导向 Republic。: The current city service page directs residential waste account setup, cancellation and billing inquiries to Republic.
仅服务其互助水公司范围；市政府目录提供服务区地图和联系入口。: Serves only its mutual water company area; the city directory provides the service-area map and contact links.
市政府现行目录列 Veolia 为运营方；先查页面的供水区地图。: The current city directory lists Veolia as the operator; check its water service-area map first.
市政府列为本市垃圾、回收和堆肥收运商；新账户和迁移按地址向 Republic 确: The city identifies Republic as its garbage, recycling and compost collection provider; confirm account setup or transfer with Republic using your address.
服务 Willows 的一小部分；通过市政府地图确认地址。: Serves a small part of the Willows; verify your address using the city map.
仅涉及 Menalto Avenue 的少量地址；通过市政府地图确认。: Covers a small number of Menalto Avenue addresses; confirm using the city map.
本行适用于建制镇内；邻近非建制地区的收运方案需另按地址确认。Los Tranco: This row covers the incorporated town; collection plans in nearby unincorporated areas must be checked by address. Los Trancos water service is now part of Cal Water's Bear Gulch district.
2026 年 1 月 1 日起垃圾服务由 Recology 直接出账；水费仍向市: Since January 1, 2026, Recology bills waste service directly; municipal water accounts remain with the city.
市政府办理住宅水务；垃圾另向 Recology San Bruno 开户。Cry: The city handles residential water accounts; contact Recology San Bruno separately for waste service. The upstream supply arrangement for Crystal Springs Terrace does not mean residents should open a separate NCCWD account.
Seal Slough 以东部分区域由 EMID 供水；先核对地址，不是全市。: EMID supplies part of the area east of Seal Slough; confirm the address, as this does not cover the whole city.
服务 Westborough 水区；通过水区地图或客服核对。: Serves the Westborough water district; confirm with its service-area map or customer service.
部分 Emerald Lake Hills 邻近地址由 Redwood City: Some addresses near Emerald Lake Hills receive Redwood City water; confirm the parcel first.
先用市政府 Service Finder 输入地址，区分 San Jose Wa: Enter your address in the city's Service Finder to distinguish San Jose Water from Cal Water; apartment residents should ask management about the waste account.
收运问题找 Recology；垃圾账户及账单联系市 Utility Billin: Contact Recology about collection; contact city Utility Billing at 650-903-6317 about waste accounts and bills.
垃圾收运与容器问题联系 GreenWaste；搬家时同时向市公用事业确认垃圾账单: Contact GreenWaste for waste collection and containers; also confirm refuse billing with city utilities when moving.
Palo Alto 市营公用事业提供电、水及天然气；不要把 East Palo: Palo Alto's municipal utility provides electricity, water and natural gas; do not apply this row to East Palo Alto or Stanford addresses.
市营电力，开户和迁移直接找 CPAU。: Municipal electricity; open or transfer your account directly with CPAU.
新住宅垃圾服务及账户问题先从市政府入口办理；再按地址、住宅类型和垃圾类别确定承包: Start with the city portal for residential waste service and account questions, then identify the contractor by address, housing type and material stream.
Downtown、North、East、South 区的垃圾收运；具体地址以市政: Garbage collection in Downtown, North, East and South areas; confirm the specific address with the city's lookup.
Downtown、North、East、South 区的回收收运；不能当作全市垃: Recycling collection in Downtown, North, East and South areas; this is not the citywide garbage account provider.
West San José 的垃圾与回收，以及公寓和共管公寓的垃圾与回收；按地址: Garbage and recycling for West San José and for apartments and condominiums; confirm by address.
庭院修剪物收运与扫街；新服务按市政府指引申请。: Yard-trimming collection and street sweeping; request new service through the city's instructions.
用市政府地址查询工具确认三家供水商及垃圾分区；邮寄城市名或 ZIP code 不: Use the city address lookup to identify the water retailer and waste zone; a mailing city name or ZIP code does not determine service boundaries.
住宅垃圾账户、账单和容器容量变更先联系市公用事业。: Contact city utilities first for residential waste accounts, billing and container-size changes.
负责住宅垃圾和庭院修剪物收运。: Handles residential garbage and yard-trimming collection.
本市电力由 Silicon Valley Power 提供；PG&E 在此承担天: Silicon Valley Power provides the city's electricity. PG&E provides natural gas here and is not the municipal electric account provider.
Santa Clara 市营电力；通过市公用事业申请开户、停用和迁移。: Santa Clara's municipal electricity provider; use city utilities to start, stop or transfer service.
收运问题联系承包商；开户、停用和账单找市 Utility Billing：408: Contact the contractor for collection issues; contact city Utility Billing at 408-730-7400 for account setup, cancellation and bills.
